calls.statement: SELECT (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale, (SELECT max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) FROM fact_web_order) AS max_dispatch, (SELECT max(return_date) FROM fact_return_line) AS max_ret, (SELECT max(order_ts_utc) FROM fact_web_order) AS max_order, (SELECT min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) FROM fact_web_order WHERE dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01') AS min_disp_nov
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE period_end_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' ORDER BY period_start_date

SELECT s.store_id, o.status, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_order
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR f.channel_id IS NOT NULL) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-25'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-11-03' AS start_date, DATE '2026-10-04' AS end_date),
web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS sold, 0 AS refunded, f.sales_line_id AS lid
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, 0, r.refund_net, NULL
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
  sum(n.sold) AS sold_net, sum(n.refunded) AS refunds, sum(n.sold - n.refunded) AS web_net_sales, count(n.lid) AS lines, count(DISTINCT n.lid) AS dlines
FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY web_net_sales DESC LIMIT 15

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
mine AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS d, f.net_amount AS amt FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT (SELECT sum(amt) FROM mine WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS mine_total,
 (SELECT sum(net_sales) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04') AS rpt_total,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line) AS n_lines, (SELECT count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line) AS n_dist_id,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_line,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.product_key IS NULL) AS orphan_prod
